<div style="background: #475715; border:1px solid #b9b61e; padding: 5px; margin: 3px; text-align: center; font-size: 120%; color:#fff;">'''About the Mod'''</div>
<div style="padding: 0em 1em;">
The ''Scape and Run: Parasites'' Mod focuses on adding various types of Parasitic Mobs, an ever-growing threat whose forces consist of bastardizations of Vanilla Mobs to refined beings constructed with flesh, capable of converting the ''Minecraft'' World and its inhabitants into killing machines, capable of evolving and adapting. 

The Mod is based on [https://www.halopedia.org/Flood Flood], [https://thething.fandom.com/wiki/The_Thing_(Organism) the Thing] and [https://deadspace.fandom.com/wiki/Necromorphs Necromorphs], picking elements from each of these works of fiction, combining and incorporating them in order to create a unique ''Horror Mod''.
